Oct 26 (Reuters) – Ben & Jerry’s founders are exploring a deal with an executive from KKR to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday. The ice cream brand is owned by Unilever spin-off Magnum. KKR’s global co-head of private equity, Pete Stavros, has be

The structure would give rank-and-file employees stock while providing the company with tax benefits, the report added.

Magnum, KKR, and Ben and Jerry’s did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
